title: G12C1 holds on, 59–56, in the basketball final
excerpt: A one-possession finish puts G12C1 on top of the six-team bracket.
body:
G12C1 closed the basketball championship 59–56 over G12C2, after both sides had gone unbeaten in group play.

Leo Hart finished with 21, and Marcus Hale had 11 boards. G12C2 stayed in it behind Ethan Cole’s 18, but missed a look that would have tied it in the last minute.

The two G12 sides had already taken Group A and Group B. Semifinals: G12C1 54–46 G11C2, G12C2 57–53 G11C1.

title: Group A: G12C1 stays unbeaten
excerpt: A 62–44 win over G10C1 locks first place in Group A.
body:
G12C1 moved to 2–0 in Group A with a 62–44 result against G10C1. G11C1 still had a path to the second seed, which they took later with a 49–47 win over the same G10C1 side.

Group B mirrored the shape: G12C2 on top, G11C2 in second.

Knockout pairings are A1 vs B2 and B1 vs A2.

title: Welcome to DataBall!
excerpt: School sports, scores, and stories — in one place.
body:
Hi guys! Welcome to DataBall!
This is our DDHS sports desk: a home for scores, brackets, rankings, Elo, records, and the stories behind match day. Basketball, soccer, volleyball, and frisbee all live here — along with classes, players, and the league as it unfolds.

Check today’s games, read the latest posts, and follow your class through the season. Editors will keep the board updated; everyone else is invited to watch, share, and stay in the conversation.

Glad you’re here. Have fun and let’s go!

—
